integrity: Mathematical proof uses published complete-graph Hom wedge theorem, standard finite-group periodic resolution, integral C3-lattice classification and elementary spectral sequence/UCT arguments. Full text of some later related indexed records was inaccessible.
scientific_limitations: Integral module decomposition is abstract and has no explicit geometrically canonical cycle basis; no complete higher homotopy type of the quotient is claimed. The finite checks do not prove the infinite case. Equivalent unindexed literature remains possible.
title: Integral source-rotation homology lattices and mod-three cohomology of complete-graph coloring complexes
